node.title: C1' DYADIC-K (ledger form): near-peak mass <= K' * r * (1 + W_cl(row)), K' <= 4
node.statement: RE-POSED after F-round refutation (2026-07-07): the frozen uniform form (K <= 3.34 x iid at all balanced rows) is REFUTED — natural cluster rows give K = 23.2/10.9/3.77 at j = 20/24/28 (q=204353, k=7); the K x iid normalization ignores that generator/cluster mass is absolute (window-law instance #11). STATUS: fresh conjecture — calibrated at 4 rows, has survived ZERO adversarial rounds; F-round dossier in notes/F_ROUND_CONJECTURE_FALSIFICATION.md. F-ROUND VERDICT: frozen form REFUTED, C1' successor calibrated — statement above is the re-pose. [RESTATEMENT r2 (2026-07-13, wave-6; the branch's clean pose, appended per #104 preserving the F-round history above): For every generated prime-field full-half-section row (q,n'=2N,L) with q=1 mod n', 2^N>=q^L, and N>=16L, let T(lambda), E, and r=q^L/2^N be as in C1PRIME_LEVEL_SCALED_POSE.md. With w_max(L)=L+5 and W_cl the primitive signed-shift orbit ledger over L+1<=w<=L+5, E-1 <= 4r(1+W_cl). This candidate survived one pre-registered 12-row round but is unproved; it is evidence toward marginal baseline coverage, not a logical premise of B-WEAK.] || REFUTED (2026-07-13, F-ROUND 2; packet notes/c1r2_fround2_20260713/, catches c1r2-C1..): the level-scaled pose is FALSE as stated. The literal kill E-1 > 4r(1+W_cl) (K' = (E-1)/(r(1+W_cl)) > 4) fired at three in-hypothesis rows (L=1, N=32, q prime, q=1 mod 64, 2^32>=q, RAW ledger per decision 4a): q=63361 K'=6.199 (W_cl=76, (E-1)/r=477), q=65921 K'=4.481, q=204353 K'=4.285 (the node's OWN k=7 cluster row that motivated the r2 re-pose). Worst K'=6.199, guaranteed global max over the L=1 scan to 262144. Positive control reproduced M2 exactly on the RAW ledger (q=7937 -> K'=0.2469, W_cl=236); mutation (W_cl:=0) fires the kill; brute-force weight-3 witness + verbatim banked kernels agree; NO convention weakened. RE-POSE OWED (round 3, genuine research, NOT bookkeeping): price the weight-3 orbit's full multiplier-shadow/cluster mass across ALL weights + calibrate the TRUE constant (which is > 4 and may not close the 2^100 baseline); number-theoretic handle on weight-3 accident primes q | Norm(zeta^a +- zeta^b +- zeta^c). Whether a repaired C1' exists is OPEN and uncertain. || C1'-r3 PROGRAM, ROUND 1 (2026-07-19; packet notes/c1r3_program_20260719/; ~30 Modal shards; catches c1r3-C1..C9 = #296-#304): the repaired pose — official-admissibility gate v_2(q-1) >= 41 (analogue proxy >= 20 via Proth rows) + the EXTENDED ledger W_ext (window L+1..L+7), allowance 4 UNCHANGED, assembly arithmetic preserved (41^34 < 2^202, 19.84 bits slack) at the cost of SIX new zone emptiness slots (1,7),(1,8),(2,8),(2,9),(4,10),(4,11) if adopted (ell >= 8 extended windows Newton-empty for free). BOTH r2 killers DOUBLY neutralized: gate-excluded (v_2 = 7/7/6) AND repriced under W_ext (K'_ext 1.77/1.31/2.07 < 4). GATE-MIRROR theorem-grade (weight-3 norm census max v_2 = 16 < 20; w3/w4/w5 channels empty at ALL 401 gated primes < 2^32; one w6 exception 918552577 DEFERRED to round 2).
